source_of_declaration: modern/experiments/cft_orbit_wall_loss_v3/protocol.json (branch exp/cft-orbit-wall-loss-v3) field_adapter.maps.primary and .refined; hashes re-verified against the committed artifacts at load time
sampling_region_justification: All five regions carry reluctivity 1/mu_0 and no source in the P2 problem, so A_phi is smooth across their geometric interfaces; the PIC samples psi over the whole channel bounding box r in [0, 3 mm], z in [0, 24 mm]. Ferromagnetic, magnet and anode regions are never sampled.

primary.spacing_note: dr = 0.125 mm, dz = 0.25 mm: identical spacing to the orbit campaign primary map

refined.spacing_note: dr = 0.0625 mm, dz = 0.125 mm: identical spacing to the orbit campaign refined map

field_convention: B_r = -r dg/dz, B_z = 2 g + r dg/dr with g = (psi - psi_axis)/r^2 (cft_revival.orbit_mc.fields.PsiBicubicField); equivalently B_r = -(1/r) dpsi/dz, B_z = (1/r) dpsi/dr
